description: Search case law publicly and, with a CourtListener token, build bounded docket briefs, relationship maps, filing watches, and RECAP availability audits.

novel_features.name: Chronological docket brief
novel_features.description: Join one authenticated docket with bounded entries, documents, parties, and counsel in source chronology.

novel_features.name: New-filing watch report
novel_features.description: Persist a bounded newest-first search observation and report newly observed CourtListener result IDs.

novel_features.name: Cross-docket party map
novel_features.description: Query authenticated party records by exact supplied name while preserving docket and API identifiers.

novel_features.name: Recurring counsel map
novel_features.description: Query authenticated attorney records by supplied name and retain observed docket and party relationships.

novel_features.name: Non-predictive judge context
novel_features.description: Return sourced judge/person metadata and clearly prohibit outcome prediction or causal scoring.

novel_features.name: RECAP availability audit
novel_features.description: Classify bounded docket document records by CourtListener availability fields without implying complete PACER coverage.
